predicted_reason: These DIY Crochet Shoe Kits are classified under heading 6405, HTSUS, which covers footwear with outer soles of rubber, plastics, leather or composition leather, and heading 6405.20.30 applies specifically to 'other footwear with outer soles of other materials and upper of leather.' Heading 6405.90.90 covers 'other footwear with outer soles of other materials and uppers of textile materials.' The pre-cut felt and yarn components in various colors and sizes for creating shoe uppers indicate that these kits fall under textile materials, while the use of rubber or plastic soles is not mentioned, so the more specific classification is 6405.20.30.
